translation.name: Waom Yesu Wane Sigi Maep Don

content: Abrahamŋo Mali Malip Wane Numa Gesoke Ŋebonge Yewaka Gesokkene
Abraham, ŋenane solaoken qerakze, ŋene eŋane daleo raikene? Eŋe daleo okange?
Eŋe tanik manik maine okangi Anuturop koboboine birakakeo, yemo eŋe ea wane maine eŋine mawa nagukirap. Ŋo siluŋ eŋe Anutu wane kaitko mi mawa naguke.
Ea wane Anutu wane papiao yale ramaike, “Abraham eŋe Anutu detlukkake, so onoka wane mida, mali malipine ea wane raki paki, Anutu eŋe detkaki, ŋei koboboine okange.”
Ŋei mane urata mayake, eŋe lewine qolekaikei, lewine qolekamami, ea eŋe yaup wet pese wane bakom okan kamami, mi okanmaike. Ea yemo eŋe urata mamaike, ea wane lewine okanmaike.

Ŋo ŋei mane eŋe mali malip mageake, eŋe urata mi mayake, eŋe Anutuŋo ŋei borikine mama raki, sotene midaine okanmami, eŋe detluk kayake, yemo eŋe mali malipine ea wane raki paki detki, koboboine okangi, eŋinerop birakaki geake.
Dawit eŋe Anutuŋo ŋei mane urata natne mi mama geki, Anutuŋo wet pese okankaki paki, ŋei koboboine ra more mayake, ea wane eŋe wet pese desiake, don iwa yale rake,

content.text: “Wet pese desikei ŋei yewa eŋane borikineenane turuŋine Anutuŋo qelige ebonge, eŋane borikineene mataliki siukke!
Wet pese desiake ŋei ea wane borikineine Waomŋo baŋ mi motki payake!”

content: Ŋei wetpese desikei wane don, Dawit eŋe rake, yewa eŋe ŋeiwa solaene piwitne kitatkoi eŋane rake me? Mida, eamo eŋe ŋeiwa solaene piwitne mi kita kitatne eŋane weneŋ rake. Ŋene Anutu wane papiao don iwa yale detmaine, “Abraham eŋe Anutu detlukkake, so onoka wane mida, eŋine mali malipinane raki paki, Anutuŋo detkaki, ŋei koboboine yale okange.”
Naso diawao iwa wakonge? Iwa eŋe alakan me ŋado Abraham solaine piwitne kitatke naso yewao? Iwamo alakan wakonge, ŋado solaine piwitne kitatkoi, yewao mida.

Eŋe solaine piwitne ŋado kitatkoi, pakiso eŋane sola kita kitatine, yewaŋo yemo oŋa oŋa, eaŋo kine qe wakonge, onoka wane mida, Abraham wane mali malipinane ra more, Anutuŋo detkaki, eŋe alakan ŋei koboboine okangi, ŋado eŋe solaine piwitne kitatkoi, eso ea wane Abraham eŋe lewine alakane, ŋeiwa korop diawa edo Anutu detluk kamami, eŋane magaene okange paki, Anutuŋo detki menaŋgi, eŋe solaene piwitne mi kita kitatneŋo siluŋ detongi, eŋe ŋei koboboine okangei.

Eŋe yaleka ŋeiwa solaene piwitne kita kitatne, eŋane magaene weneŋ okanmaike, onoka wane eŋe solaene piwitne kita kitatne ea wane mida, ŋo yemo iwa yale wane, eŋe gege wekuka mali malip korop gekei, ŋenane magaze Abrahamŋo olakan gege geki, ŋado solaine piwitne kitatkoi, yale.
Anutu Wane Don Yemo Mali Malip Wane Ra More Wele Maratkaikene

Anutuŋo Abraham eŋine so doko ŋosakoune mali malip weneŋ qeli so kepe suaine ea eŋane leleakane biŋek qe more edange warekaikei. Don iwa edange, yemo onoka wane Abrahamŋo ra rokop don tewekkane mida, ŋo yemo eŋe detlukaki, ea wane raki paki, Anutuŋo detkaki, ŋei koboboine okange.
Anutuŋo ra rokop don tewek okanmami, eŋe biŋek qe eboniakane don edangirap, yemo ŋei eŋane mali malipŋo wele midaine okangirap, pakimo Anutu wane don sap saune okangirap.
Ra rokop donŋo Anutu wane sot osi osi tebakaki sariake, ŋo ra rokop don mane yewa mi payakeo, yemo ra rokop don dere ŋade ŋadek, ea mi payake.

Biŋek qe more don eda edan, ea yemo mali malipŋo pekeine motke, ea wane biŋek qeqe don, ea yemo Anutu wane bakom lewine midaine Abraham wane doko ŋosakoune korop eŋane biŋek okan waremaike. Ra rokop donka dere tewekmami, ŋei yewa eŋaneka mida, ŋo yemo ŋeiwa diawa edo Abrahamŋo okange, yale detluk kamami, eŋane weneŋ okanmaike. Abraham yemo eŋe mali malip korop ŋenane magaze okanmaike.

Ea wane Anutu wane papiao iwa yale ramaike, “Na kepe baŋem ŋei loutne eŋane magaene geukole.” Eso ea wane biŋek qeqe don, ea yemo Anutu wane kaitko maine okanmaike, Abrahamŋo eŋe detlukkake, Anutu oŋo ŋei seu seune eŋe gege ma wakone ebon okanmaike, so eŋane donŋo raki, kine kine mi wakongoi, yewa wakon wareake.

Abraham eŋe dere qekaki paki, siluŋ ea detlukkake, so ea wane dereret geke, eso eŋe yale okangi paki, “Kepe baŋem ŋei korop eŋane magaene okange.” Anutu wane papiaŋo don iwa yale ramaike, ea wane rokopko, “Geŋane doko ŋosokopŋone eŋe baŋ iwa serekin magu yale loutne manerop okangei.”
Eŋe komaine mo wan handret (100) maratka yakane okange, ŋo siluŋ eŋine mali malipineŋo mi pelekke, naso eŋe solaine zokongi, solainane wetkekeo, me Saraŋo medep mi ebuke, yewao.
Eŋine mali malipineŋo mi qeliŋkake, so eŋe Anutu wane biŋek qeqe don olatke, ea wane wet etkeka mi okange, eŋine mali malipineŋo zonom qewatkake, pakiso eŋe Anutu mawakake.
Eŋe Anutuŋo biŋek qe more don olatke, ea maine baŋ okaniake, ea mo detlukkake.
Abraham eŋe yale okangane, mali malipinane raki paki, “Anutuŋo detkaki, eŋe ŋei koboboine okange.”
Donba “Eŋe detkaki, ŋei koboboine okange,” ea yemo eŋaneka bonep mi qekoi.
Eŋe ŋenane yaleka weneŋ qekoi, ŋene eŋe Yesu Waomze seu seuo ŋine ma wirikkaki wieke, eŋe detluk kakeneo, eŋe detŋongi, ŋene ŋei koboboine okangene.
Eŋe seukeakane sunka ebonge, onoka wane ŋenane borikinane ra more, so eŋe ma wirikkaki wie more biraŋongi, Anuturop ŋei koboboine gekenane, yale okange.
